_doc: Vast.ai host quality ledger. Deployers read this to skip known-bad hosts and prefer known-good ones; every rental audition appends a verdict. Machine id is the durable key (ask/offer ids rotate; machine_id persists per physical host). Preflight bar: github+HF reachable AND measured HF throughput >= 15 MB/s.

good.notes: THE keeper. Xeon 8470 208c / 256GB RAM / Gen5 PCIe 53GB/s / enterprise NVMe 6.5GB/s. Measured 24 MB/s to HF. Cold start: boot 24s, ssh 19s, preflight 13s, setup 2m42s (zero compile, wheelhouse), Blackwell PTX JIT smoke 34s. ~$0.96/hr. reliability 0.9993.
The original igen pod (instance 46176315, root@ssh7.vast.ai:16314). Full bootstrap + wheelhouse build done here. HF upload measured ~26 MB/s. Reliable across many hours 2026-07-29/30.

The challenger. Ryzen 9 7950X 32c. Passed full audition. CLEAN cold-start record: rent->ready 5m17s (boot 25s, ssh 4s, preflight 14s, scripts 17s, setup 3m48s zero-compile, smoke 29s w/ 22.4s Blackwell JIT). ~$0.46/hr. root@ssh6.vast.ai:20274.

bad.verdict: no egress to github.com AND huggingface.co (both timeout); pypi+naver fine. Unusable for HF-centric flow.
egress reachable but measured HF throughput ~1 MB/s vs 800+ Mbps advertised. Bundle download would take ~30 min. Rejected by bandwidth gate.
HF throughput 2 MB/s — below 15 MB/s bar.
